parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid from the bottle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head part connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and the tube inside the bottle. It is made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the nozzle when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but contains internal moving components that facilitate liquid flow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent or translucent PET plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (such as soap, lotion, or sanitizer) that is dispensed through the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the entire dispenser.
